title: schedule.invitation_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the schedule module, in the transaction of the change, when an invitation that awaits the member's answer opens, changes or closes (campbooks-cloud#360): an event of one of the member's provider calendars that syncs, which the member was asked to (`needs_action`) and did not organise, a single event or a series, not cancelled, deleted or started. `revision` grows with every announcement of the event's invitation, so a consumer applies only newer ones; `invitation` is present while it awaits an answer, `closed_because` once it does not. Ids, a day, a time and flags only: never the title, the place or who asked. Workspace-scoped.

owner.description: The member whose calendar it is, who is asked.

on.description: The day the event starts, in the member's time zone.

lapses_at.description: When it stops awaiting an answer: when the event starts, or for an all-day event when its first day ends.

from_person.description: Whether a person rather than a machine sent it, from the organiser's address alone; absent when unknown.
